regeln: Start every video with a highly visual, specific, and engaging hook without giving away the core twist or explaining success through early background details.
Ensure every single scene features dynamic, contextually accurate visual clips or animations instead of relying on static backgrounds.
Omit serial markers like Part 1 or Part 2 from the text and screen to avoid confusing viewers in short-form videos.
Eliminate corporate jargon, technical financial figures, and biographical filler to maintain high retention.
Replace generic narrative transitions with engaging, specific hooks that sustain momentum through the middle section.
Design unique, story-specific calls to action that blend smoothly into the final seconds for a seamless loop without repeating the opening hook.
Verify that characters, settings, and time periods depicted in visuals accurately reflect the specific details mentioned in the voiceover without appearing generic.
